The '''Anavaisk-Novoanov Accords''' were the 1352 constitutional settlement that created the [[Duma of Ledostrov]].

== Background ==

After a series of ineffective dukes, Ledostrov's noble council deposed the sitting duke. The council elevated the [[Prince of Novoanov]] but required a more permanent governing arrangement before accepting the new order.

== Terms ==

The accords created a Duma composed of landed nobles owing allegiance to the duke. The Duma received authority over declarations of war, budget changes, and foreign treaties by simple majority. Ducal elections required a two-thirds majority.

The accords also created a regency rule: if no two-thirds majority could be reached after a duke's death, the eldest child of the previous duke would serve as regent until a new duke was elected.

== Legacy ==

The Accords stabilized Ledostrov's constitutional duchy for centuries, but the same noble privileges later contributed to budget paralysis, corruption, and the crises that produced the [[Battle of Lisebev]] and the [[Pentarchy of Ledostrov]].
